title: isidrogalvia calyculata

It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant species.
